about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (1,2) with a folder of RedWave A in both games, BN5's chip 173 by BN5's own code and the registry's 481 by the same code moved (BN5's misc family 0x1A as BN6's 0x6A), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30 on BN5's field 0x73 (lava at columns 2 and 5 of row 2) as BN6's (xpanels.c's lava), its waves rising from the lava (its kind 1: a panel of flag 0x1000, lava's in both): every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
